name: code-review

events.JOB/START/PENDING: Actor accepts the assigned step; no execution claimed
events.JOB/ACQUIRE/SUCCESS: Actor claims its assigned step for this attempt
events.JOB/START/SUCCESS: Actor has started the assigned step
events.JOB/COMPLETE/SUCCESS: Actor completed its step and its criteria
events.JOB/COMPLETE/FAILED: Actor reports failure; parent stays open

rules: Operator assigns work in the agents topic after human confirmation of mandate M1
Ticket 1 belongs to TASK-001 in owner code-review and topic review/agents
Actor IDs describe roles; match the owner-stamped message.producer_id to the provisioned stable client identity
All participants explicitly accept this revision before using its event meanings
Claude starts only after Codex completion, artifact reference, and operator review assignment
Operator completes the parent only after required coding and review results
ACK means receipt, never business success; unknown publish outcomes require reconciliation
Human-topic instructions override this agreement; stops block affected work
No automatic retry, attempt increment, or protocol revision switch on timeout
